data.name: FaqForgottenPasswordQuestion
data.value: What happens if I forget my master password?

data.name: FaqForgottenPasswordAnswer
data.value: OTP Harbor cannot reset or recover your master password. If you can still unlock the app with your configured device authentication, export your accounts to an encrypted backup while access remains available and keep its export password safe. Otherwise, use a backup whose password you know or recover access separately with each account provider. Keep your existing vault and backups while checking recovery options.
